issues: PieChart appears empty when no production data exists (all values 0). This is expected behavior but could show a 'No data' message instead of empty chart area.

Conversion rate calculation may show high values (1300%) when totalBudgets is low - formula is (confirmedOrders/budgets)*100
Frontend correctly uses data-testid attributes for testing (dashboard-tab, dashboard-content, dashboard-period-selector)
recharts library properly integrated for BarChart and PieChart visualizations
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing production data (13 confirmed orders, 1 budget, 5405 products)
